svg.text: THREE QUESTIONS A RULE CAN'T ANSWER — SHOWN WHERE THE QUESTION IS ASKED
How far does this reach?
above each method: callers, the projects
they sit in, and tests that reach it
matched on name + argument count —
no symbols, so counts are prefixed ~
depth-capped test counts are prefixed ≥
graph held warm: ~578 ms to build,
~23 ms to query after
Why does this line exist?
hover: the commit that last changed it —
author, age, message body, issue link
only the hovered line is blamed, so cost
doesn't grow with file size
archon.history.issueUrl is a {key} template —
any tracker, none named in the tool
What did this branch change?
review mode dims what a file shares with
the base ref, summarising each changed run
base ref = merge-base with the upstream
branch, so it's this branch, not upstream drift
status bar: how many findings fall inside
the change — needs diff + findings together
None of these has a yes-or-no answer, so none is a rule. They report in the editor gutter and hovers, never the Problems panel,
and the one that needs the diff and the findings at once is the thing three separate extensions could not have done.
